vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
contado: contar — renowned, esteemed (past part. used as a standing epithet of the Campeador) · also of others: un Burgalés contado, 'a renowned man of Burgos' (Martín Antolínez)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another')
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que)
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word'
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already'
alfonsso: Alfonsso — Alfonso (VI, king of León and Castile)
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara)
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt')
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak')
fata: fata — until, as far as (variant of fasta; = hasta)
sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route)
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
lança: lança — lance (= lanza); ardida lança, 'bold lance', stands for the bold man who wields it
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least'
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping'
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly'
ayuso: ayuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; no modern equivalent, closest abajo)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro)
quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as')
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
dinero: dinero — penny (a small coin, the unit of smallest denomination)
malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro)
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
çinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Latin cinxit)
quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le) · that ... to him (quel creçe conpaña 'that company grows for him')
mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil')
partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part')
tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have')
sin: sin — without · also sin — 'besides, apart from' (sin las peonadas 'besides the foot-soldiers'); sin falla 'without fail'; sin dubda
falla: falla — failure, lack (noun; sin falla 'without fail'; = falla, closest falta)
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus)
gelos: ge + los — them to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + los; = se los)
diessen: dar — they should give (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = diesen)
i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do'
uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró)
dellos: de + ellos — of them, from them (contraction)
çient: çient — hundred (apocopated before a noun; = cien)
marcos: marco — mark (a unit of weight for silver, pl.)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them')
dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses'
fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
castejón: Castejón — Castejón, a town taken by the Cid, traditionally Castejón de Henares (Guadalajara province); not the modern Navarrese Castejón
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
fita: Fita — Hita, town in Guadalajara province (f- for h-; = Hita; traditional identification)
guadalfajara: Guadalfajara — Guadalajara, city on the Henares (Arabic wādī al-ḥijāra 'river of stones'; = Guadalajara)
quinta: quinta — fifth, the fifth part of the booty, a share due by custom (= quinta; legal quinto, 'a fifth')
serié: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería)
aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day')
ganançia: ganançia — gain, profit, interest (= ganancia) · also booty, spoils of war (de ganançia 'as booty'; feremos grand ganançia 'we shall take great spoils')
plogo: plazer — it pleased (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = plugo, modern plació)
aquesta: aquesta — this (fem. sg., reinforced demonstrative; = esta, archaic aquesta)
castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos) · also the castle of Castejón (el castiello dexó en so poder)
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us')
mesnada: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (= mesnada)
quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar)
minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana)
pensemos: pensar — let us set about (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortation; pensar de + inf.; = pensemos)
querría: querer — I would like, would want (conditional 1st sg.)
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
parten: partir — they part, separate (present 3rd pl.; = parten)
están: estar — they are, stay (present 3rd pl.; = están)
vansse: ir + se — they go off (present 3rd pl. van + enclitic se, spelled -ss-; = se van)
fenares: Fenares — the river Henares (f- for h-; = Henares)
arriba: arriba — up, upward (adverb; = arriba) · also postposed 'up, upstream' (Fenares arriba 'up the Henares'; desí arriba 'from there upward')
andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
ivan: ir — they were going (imperfect 3rd pl.; ivan posar 'they were going to lodge'; = iban)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
passando: passar — passing (gerund; Passando va la noch 'the night keeps passing'; = pasando)
entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
iva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg.; iva posar 'was going to halt'; = iba)
priso: prender — he took (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = prendió, tomó)
tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero')
bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
passó: passar — he passed, crossed (preterite 3rd sg.; = pasó)
posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar)
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection')
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
